---
title: "Differential Arrest State Profile (dASP) Discovery and DEG Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

# Overview

This notebook covers the full dASP pipeline in three sequential stages:

**Stage 1 — dASP Discovery**
Patients are clustered by the log2 fold-change (LFC) of blast cell arrest state
frequencies between MRD and IDX timepoints. Each arrest state is defined by the
healthy donor cell type that a leukemic blast projects onto (Projected.Ctype.Wmethod).
K-means clustering on row-scaled LFC values (k = 4, including myeloid cell types)
produces four differential Arrest State Profiles (dASPs) used in all downstream analyses.

**Stage 2 — Pseudobulk DEG Analysis**
Within each dASP, MAST is used to identify genes differentially expressed between
MRD and IDX blast cells (regressing patient ID). Genes are then filtered, adjusted
for multiple testing, and compared across dASPs via UpSet plots and common-gene
analyses.

**Stage 3 — Manuscript GO Enrichment Plots**
---

# USER CONFIGURATION

Edit all paths in this block before running. No other chunk needs to change.

```{r config}
# ── Input files ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Per-cell blast metadata with arrest-state labels, PT.number, Stage, MRD.Group,
# Daunorubicin, Ctype.Aggregate, and Projected.Ctype.Wmethod columns.
# Pre-aggregated: one row per cell (filtered to Blast, IDX/MRD only, PT17/PT5 removed).
path.blast.metadata    <- "/path/to/Tables/metadata_blast_aggregateCtype.csv"

# Global blast RNA Seurat object (IDX and MRD timepoints only)
path.global.rna        <- "/path/to/R_Objects/global.rna.blasts.onlyidxmrd.rds"

# dASP k-means cluster assignments (output of Stage 1; needed by Stage 2+)
# Written by this notebook — only needed if re-running Stage 2 from a saved file
path.dasp.clusters     <- "/path/to/Tables/Ctype_aggregated_scaled_LFC_k4clustering.csv"

# Pre-computed expression matrix across DEGs × (arrest-state × dASP) combinations
# (output of MarkerComparison_ByCluster script; needed by Stage 3)
path.consensus.matrix  <- "/path/to/Objects/ExpOfDEGs.allCtypeClusters.cellNumberPTadjusted.k4.PTregressed.MAST.rds"

# Binarised version of the above (1 = gene is a DEG in that combination, 0 = not)
path.binarized.matrix  <- "/path/to/Objects/ExpOfDEGs.allCtypeClusters.binarized.MAST.rds"

# Per-cell DEG list from ctype × dASP MAST analysis
path.ctype.degs        <- "/path/to/Objects/DEGList.allCtypeClusters.k4.PTregressed.MAST.rds"

# Pre-computed MAST DEGs (MRD vs IDX per dASP); written during Stage 2 and
# re-loaded for Stage 3. Change path if re-running Stage 2 fresh.
path.mast.degs         <- "/path/to/Objects/AllCells_RegressPtID_MAST_DEGs_MRDIDX_byTrajClusters.rds"

# Pre-computed enrichment tables for final manuscript heatmaps (from fig2 panels)
path.hallmark.csv      <- "/path/to/Figure2/PB_Hallmark_HeatmapSelectedGO.csv"
path.gobp.csv          <- "/path/to/Figure2/GO_BP_HeatmapSelectedGO.csv"

# ── Output paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dir.plots              <- "/path/to/Plots/Multiome_Projection/"
dir.objects            <- "/path/to/Objects/"
dir.tables             <- "/path/to/Tables/"

# ── Analysis parameters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Patients excluded from dASP clustering (insufficient paired data)
EXCLUDE_PATIENTS <- c("PT17", "PT5")

# Arrest state cell types to exclude from clustering (normal bystanders)
EXCLUDE_CTYPES <- c("T-cell", "NK")

# Pseudocount for log2 fold-change computation
# Set to the minimum non-zero frequency observed in the data (prevents log(0))
LFC_PSEUDOCOUNT <- 0.0003632401   # recomputed in Stage 1; override here if known

# Canonical arrest-state column order for heatmaps (developmental order)
CTYPE_ORDER <- c("HSC-MPP-LMPP", "CLP", "Pre-pro-B", "Pro-B-Pre-B",
                 "Immature-Mature-B", "Myeloid-Progenitor", "Mature-Myeloid")

# Gap column position in LFC heatmaps (separates lymphoid from myeloid)
HEATMAP_GAP_COL <- 2

# Gap row positions in final k=4 heatmap (boundaries between dASPs after sort)
HEATMAP_GAP_ROWS <- c(6, 17, 24)

# k-means parameters
KMEANS_K         <- 4    # number of dASPs (optimal by silhouette)
KMEANS_ITER      <- 100
KMEANS_SEED      <- 1

# MAST DEG thresholds
MAST_MIN_PCT     <- 0.2     # min fraction of cells expressing gene
MAST_PADJ_CUTOFF <- 0.01
MAST_LFC_CUTOFF  <- 0       # logfc.threshold in FindMarkers (filtered post-hoc)

# Biclustering parameters (BiMax, Stage 3)
BIMAX_MIN_ROWS   <- 40    # minimum genes per bicluster
BIMAX_MIN_COLS   <- 4     # minimum dASP × cell-type columns per bicluster

# GO enrichment parameters
GO_PADJ_METHOD   <- "BH"
GO_PVAL_CUTOFF   <- 0.05
GO_QVAL_CUTOFF   <- 0.05
GO_SIMPLIFY_CUTOFF <- 0.5

# Pathway enrichment databases for enrichR
ENRICHR_DATABASES <- c("MSigDB_Hallmark_2020",
                        "GO_Biological_Process_2023",
                        "GO_Molecular_Function_2023",
                        "Reactome_2022")

# Shared annotation colour palette (used across all pheatmap calls)
ANN_COLORS <- list(
  MRD.Group    = c("<1"    = "#deebf7", ">1<5" = "#9ecae1", ">5"  = "#3182bd"),
  Subtype      = c("iAMP21"= "#e41a1c", "KMT2Ar"= "#377eb8",
                   "Ph-like"= "#4daf4a", "Ph+"   = "#984ea3"),
  Daunorubicin = c("TRUE"  = "#7570b3", "FALSE" = "#e7298a"),
  k_4_Myeloid  = setNames(brewer.pal(4, "Set2"), as.character(1:4))
)
```

---

# STAGE 1: dASP Discovery
## 1.1 Load and prepare blast metadata

```{r load-metadata}
metadata.blast <- read.csv(path.blast.metadata, row.names = 1)

# Aggregate arrest-state frequencies per patient per stage
# Exclude T/NK bystanders and patients with insufficient data
Ctype_count_byStage <- metadata.blast %>%
  group_by(Patient.Sample, Stage) %>%
  mutate(n = n()) %>%
  group_by(Patient.Sample, Stage, Ctype.Aggregate) %>%
  mutate(cell_n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(freq = cell_n / n) %>%
  dplyr::select(-patient_bc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Stage         %in% c("IDX", "MRD"),
         Ctype.Aggregate %notin% EXCLUDE_CTYPES,
         PT.number       %notin% EXCLUDE_PATIENTS)

cat("Samples included:", n_distinct(Ctype_count_byStage$Patient.Sample), "\n")
cat("Arrest state categories:", n_distinct(Ctype_count_byStage$Ctype.Aggregate), "\n")
```

## 1.2 Compute log2 fold-change (MRD / IDX) per arrest state per patient

A small pseudocount (`LFC_PSEUDOCOUNT`) is added before log-transformation to
avoid log(0) for absent cell types. The pseudocount is set to the minimum
non-zero observed frequency, making it data-driven rather than arbitrary.

```{r compute-lfc}
# Recompute pseudocount from data
freq_values     <- sort(unique(Ctype_count_byStage$freq))
LFC_PSEUDOCOUNT <- freq_values[1]
cat("Pseudocount:", LFC_PSEUDOCOUNT, "\n")

Ctype_count_byStage_lfc <- Ctype_count_byStage %>%
  dplyr::select(Ctype.Aggregate, Stage, Subtype, PT.number,
                freq, MRD.Group, Daunorubicin) %>%
  group_by(Ctype.Aggregate, PT.number) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Stage, values_from = freq) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  mutate(lfc = log2((MRD + LFC_PSEUDOCOUNT) / (IDX + LFC_PSEUDOCOUNT)))

# Wide patient × arrest-state matrix of LFC values
lfc.to.plot <- Ctype_count_byStage_lfc %>%
  dplyr::select(-MRD, -IDX) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Ctype.Aggregate, values_from = lfc) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0)

# Separate metadata and numeric matrix
metadata.lfc <- lfc.to.plot %>%
  dplyr::select(PT.number, Subtype, MRD.Group) %>%
  left_join(metadata.blast %>% dplyr::select(MRD, PT.number, Daunorubicin),
            by = "PT.number") %>%
  distinct()

metadata.to.plot.lfc <- metadata.lfc[, -1] %>% as.data.frame()
metadata.to.plot.lfc$Subtype      <- as.factor(metadata.to.plot.lfc$Subtype)
metadata.to.plot.lfc$MRD          <- as.numeric(metadata.to.plot.lfc$MRD)
metadata.to.plot.lfc$MRD.Group    <- as.factor(metadata.to.plot.lfc$MRD.Group)
metadata.to.plot.lfc$Daunorubicin <- as.factor(metadata.to.plot.lfc$Daunorubicin)
rownames(metadata.to.plot.lfc)    <- metadata.lfc$PT.number

final.to.plot.lfc <- lfc.to.plot[, -(1:4)] %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(final.to.plot.lfc) <- lfc.to.plot$PT.number
```

## 1.3 Row-scale LFC and annotate with absolute cell counts

Row-scaling normalises each patient's LFC profile to unit variance, so that
patients with large absolute shifts in one arrest state do not dominate clustering.

```{r scale-lfc}
scaled.row.lfc <- as.data.frame(t(scale(t(final.to.plot.lfc))))
rownames(scaled.row.lfc) <- rownames(final.to.plot.lfc)

# Enforce developmental column ordering for all heatmaps
final.to.plot.lfc  <- final.to.plot.lfc  %>% relocate(all_of(CTYPE_ORDER))
scaled.row.lfc     <- scaled.row.lfc     %>% relocate(all_of(CTYPE_ORDER))

# Build per-patient cell count annotation for heatmap display_numbers
Ctype_count_summary <- Ctype_count_byStage %>%
  arrange(PT.number, Ctype.Aggregate, Stage) %>%
  dplyr::select(PT.number, Ctype.Aggregate, Stage, cell_n, n) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(cell_fraction = paste0(Stage, ":", cell_n, "/", n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-cell_n, -n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Stage, values_from = cell_fraction) %>%
  mutate(cell_fraction_label = paste0(MRD, " || ", IDX)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-IDX, -MRD) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Ctype.Aggregate, values_from = cell_fraction_label) %>%
  column_to_rownames("PT.number")
```

## 1.4 Determine optimal k by silhouette analysis

```{r silhouette, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
set.seed(KMEANS_SEED)
fviz_nbclust(scaled.row.lfc, kmeans, method = "silhouette") +
  labs(subtitle = "Silhouette — row-scaled LFC (all arrest states including myeloid)",
       title    = "Optimal k for dASP clustering")
```

## 1.5 K-means clustering (k = 4, final dASP assignment)

k = 4 is selected as the optimal number of dASPs by silhouette analysis.
All seven arrest-state categories (including myeloid) are included as this
captures the full spectrum of blast differentiation trajectories.

```{r kmeans-clustering}
set.seed(KMEANS_SEED)
k_dasp <- kmeans(scaled.row.lfc, iter.max = KMEANS_ITER,
                  centers = KMEANS_K)$cluster %>%
  as.factor() %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(k_dasp) <- "k_4_Myeloid"

# Merge cluster assignments with LFC data and metadata, sort by dASP then subtype
metadata.to.plot.lfc.dasp <- merge(metadata.to.plot.lfc, k_dasp, by = "row.names") %>%
  mutate(Subtype  = factor(Subtype, levels = c("KMT2Ar", "Ph+", "Ph-like", "iAMP21"))) %>%
  arrange(k_4_Myeloid, Subtype)
rownames(metadata.to.plot.lfc.dasp) <- metadata.to.plot.lfc.dasp$Row.names

dasp.data.ordered <- merge(scaled.row.lfc, k_dasp, by = "row.names") %>%
  arrange(k_4_Myeloid)
rownames(dasp.data.ordered) <- dasp.data.ordered$Row.names

# Re-order rows of data to match metadata sort order (dASP then subtype)
reorder.index          <- match(metadata.to.plot.lfc.dasp$Row.names,
                                 dasp.data.ordered$Row.names)
dasp.data.ordered      <- dasp.data.ordered[reorder.index, ]
dasp.data.ordered      <- dasp.data.ordered %>%
  relocate(Row.names, all_of(CTYPE_ORDER))

cat("dASP cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(metadata.to.plot.lfc.dasp$k_4_Myeloid))
```

## 1.6 Final dASP heatmap with cell count annotations

```{r dasp-heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
pdf(file.path(dir.plots,
              "dASP_Discovery_ScaledLFC_k4_withCellCounts.pdf"),
    height = 8, width = 15)

set.seed(KMEANS_SEED)
pheatmap(dasp.data.ordered[, 2:8],
         color            = colorRampPalette(c("#4575b4", "#ffffff", "#d73027"))(100),
         breaks           = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 100),
         cluster_rows     = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         annotation_row   = metadata.to.plot.lfc.dasp[, 2:6],
         annotation_colors = ANN_COLORS,
         gaps_row         = HEATMAP_GAP_ROWS,
         gaps_col         = HEATMAP_GAP_COL,
         display_numbers  = Ctype_count_summary[
           match(rownames(dasp.data.ordered),
                 rownames(Ctype_count_summary)), ],
         main             = "dASP Clustering: Scaled LFC (MRD/IDX), k=4")

dev.off()

# Save dASP cluster assignments for downstream scripts
write.csv(dasp.data.ordered,
          file = path.dasp.clusters)
write.csv(metadata.blast,
          file = file.path(dir.tables, "Ctype_aggregated_metadata.csv"))
write.csv(Ctype_count_byStage_lfc,
          file = file.path(dir.tables, "Ctype_aggregated_LFC.csv"))

cat("dASP assignments saved to:", path.dasp.clusters, "\n")
```

# STAGE 2: Pseudobulk DEG Analysis (MAST, MRD vs IDX per dASP)
## 2.1 Load RNA object and attach dASP metadata

```{r load-rna}
global.rna <- readRDS(path.global.rna)

# Build metadata table joining dASP cluster assignments
dasp.clusters <- read.csv(path.dasp.clusters, row.names = "X") %>%
  dplyr::select(Row.names, k_4_Myeloid) %>%
  dplyr::rename(PT.number = Row.names, k_cluster = k_4_Myeloid)

metadata_to_add <- read.csv(path.blast.metadata, row.names = 1) %>%
  left_join(dasp.clusters, by = "PT.number") %>%
  filter(Stage != "RLP")

rownames(metadata_to_add) <- metadata_to_add$patient_bc

global.rna <- AddMetaData(global.rna, metadata = metadata_to_add)

# Remove T/NK bystanders
Idents(global.rna) <- "Ctype.Aggregate"
global.rna <- subset(global.rna,
                     idents = EXCLUDE_CTYPES, invert = TRUE)

cat("Cells per dASP × Stage:\n")
print(table(global.rna$k_cluster, global.rna$Stage))
```

## 2.2 Run MAST (MRD vs IDX) per dASP

Patient ID is regressed out as a latent variable. Cell counts are balanced
across timepoints by capping at 10,000 cells per group. Results are
Bonferroni-adjusted across all dASPs jointly after aggregation.

```{r mast-degs, eval=FALSE}
Idents(global.rna) <- "k_cluster"
cluster.rna.list   <- SplitObject(global.rna, split.by = "k_cluster")
cluster.rna.list   <- cluster.rna.list[order(names(cluster.rna.list))]

markers.mrd.idx <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_along(cluster.rna.list)) {
  current.sample <- cluster.rna.list[[i]]

  # Build balanced IDX and MRD barcode lists
  patient.list  <- unique(current.sample$PT.number)
  mrd.cellList  <- character(0)
  idx.cellList  <- character(0)

  for (pt in patient.list) {
    mrd.cellList <- c(mrd.cellList,
                      current.sample@meta.data %>%
                        filter(Stage == "MRD", PT.number == pt) %>%
                        pull(patient_bc))
    idx.cellList <- c(idx.cellList,
                      current.sample@meta.data %>%
                        filter(Stage == "IDX", PT.number == pt) %>%
                        pull(patient_bc))
  }

  # Cap at 10k cells per group for memory/time
  max.cells <- min(length(mrd.cellList), length(idx.cellList), 10000)
  Idents(current.sample) <- "Stage"

  markers <- FindMarkers(current.sample,
                          test.use             = "MAST",
                          ident.1              = mrd.cellList,
                          ident.2              = idx.cellList,
                          latent.vars          = "PT.number",
                          max.cells.per.ident  = max.cells,
                          min.pct              = MAST_MIN_PCT)

  markers$Gene      <- rownames(markers)
  markers$k_cluster <- i
  rownames(markers) <- NULL
  markers.mrd.idx   <- rbind(markers.mrd.idx, markers)
  cat("dASP", i, "complete:", nrow(markers), "genes\n")
}

# Jointly adjust p-values across all dASPs
markers.mrd.idx$p_val_adj <- p.adjust(markers.mrd.idx$p_val,
                                        method = "bonferroni")
saveRDS(markers.mrd.idx, file = path.mast.degs)
```

## 2.3 Filter, summarise, and compare DEGs across dASPs

```{r filter-degs, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
markers.mrd.idx     <- readRDS(path.mast.degs)
markers.mrd.idx$p_val_adj <- p.adjust(markers.mrd.idx$p_val,
                                        method = "bonferroni")
markers.mrd.idx.sig <- filter(markers.mrd.idx, p_val_adj < MAST_PADJ_CUTOFF)

```

## 2.4 GO enrichment comparison across dASPs (compareCluster)
```{r compare-cluster-go, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}
run_compare_go <- function(entrez.list) {
  res <- compareCluster(
    geneCluster    = entrez.list,
    fun            = enrichGO,
    ont            = "ALL",
    OrgDb          = org.Hs.eg.db,
    pAdjustMethod  = GO_PADJ_METHOD,
    pvalueCutoff   = GO_PVAL_CUTOFF,
    qvalueCutoff   = GO_QVAL_CUTOFF,
    keyType        = "ENTREZID"
  )
  simplify(res)
}

enrich_mrd_clusters <- run_compare_go(mrd.input.entrez)
enrich_idx_clusters <- run_compare_go(idx.input.entrez)

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "dASP_GO_compareCluster.pdf"),
    height = 10, width = 16)

enrichplot::dotplot(enrich_mrd_clusters, split = "ONTOLOGY",
                    showCategory = 8, label_format = 40,
                    title = "GO — MRD DEGs by dASP") +
  facet_wrap(ONTOLOGY ~ ., scale = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

enrichplot::dotplot(enrich_idx_clusters, split = "ONTOLOGY",
                    showCategory = 8, label_format = 40,
                    title = "GO — IDX DEGs by dASP") +
  facet_wrap(ONTOLOGY ~ ., scale = "free", ncol = 3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

dev.off()
```

## 3. Manuscript heatmaps: Hallmark and GO BP enrichment (from pre-computed CSVs)

These panels use enrichment results pre-computed across all 11 gene signatures
(R_1–R_11) and stored as CSV tables (from `fig2.cleanupPanels.Rmd`).
Column order matches R_1 through R_11 developmental ordering.

```{r fig2-hallmark-heatmap}
hallmark.tb <- read.csv(path.hallmark.csv) %>%
  relocate(R_1, R_2, R_3, R_4, R_5, R_6, R_7, R_8, R_9, R_10)

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "Fig2_Hallmark_Enrichment_Heatmap.pdf"),
    height = 4, width = 6)

pheatmap(-hallmark.tb[, 1:10],
         cluster_rows   = TRUE,
         cluster_cols   = FALSE,
         labels_row     = hallmark.tb$Description,
         treeheight_row = 0,
         color          = colorRampPalette(c("#ffffff", "#d73027"))(1001),
         breaks         = seq(0, 20, by = 0.02),
         legend_breaks  = c(0, 5, 10, 20),
         main           = "Hallmark enrichment per gene signature (−log10 p.adj)")

dev.off()
```

```{r fig2-gobp-heatmap}
gobp.tb <- read.csv(path.gobp.csv) %>%
  relocate(R_1, R_2, R_3, R_4, R_5, R_6, R_7, R_8, R_9, R_10, R_11)

pdf(file.path(dir.plots, "Fig2_GOBP_Enrichment_Heatmap.pdf"),
    height = 4, width = 6)

pheatmap(-gobp.tb[, 1:11],
         cluster_rows   = TRUE,
         cluster_cols   = TRUE,
         labels_row     = gobp.tb$Description,
         treeheight_row = 0,
         color          = colorRampPalette(c("#ffffff", "#d73027"))(501),
         breaks         = seq(0, 10, by = 0.02),
         legend_breaks  = c(0, 5, 10),
         main           = "GO BP enrichment per gene signature (−log10 p.adj)")

dev.off()
```
